hypotheses.mechanism: Abandon strict physical unity; signed manifest over split immutable root/model and mutable UDB.
hypotheses.expected_gain: Recover least privilege with lowest complexity.
hypotheses.strongest_countermechanism: Physical unity has no measurable benefit over manifest-bound split.
hypotheses.counterprediction: Physical unity has no measurable benefit over manifest-bound split.
hypotheses.falsifier: Split equals/beats one-image on deployment coherence, recovery, backup and identity.
hypotheses.minimum_test: Matched EUDI vs split deployment/recovery benchmark.
failure_modes: Split equals/beats one-image on deployment coherence, recovery, backup and identity.
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: EUDI is provisional; split remains mandatory control.

hypotheses.mechanism: MOLT: immutable prefix + append-only state epoch tail, no in-place updates.
hypotheses.expected_gain: Replace spatial byte-range trust with forward-only temporal mutation.
hypotheses.strongest_countermechanism: Append-only lineage is just WAL/event sourcing and cannot recover split isolation.
hypotheses.counterprediction: Append-only lineage is just WAL/event sourcing and cannot recover split isolation.
hypotheses.falsifier: Kernel append-only bypass modifies prefix or cost dominates split.
hypotheses.minimum_test: O_RDWR attack vs append-only broker + crash/replay matrix.
failure_modes: Kernel append-only bypass modifies prefix or cost dominates split.
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: Current EUDI defines a mutable UDB region with in-place-capable writer.

hypotheses.mechanism: Loop-device subrange projection: expose only tail offsets as bounded block device to state engine.
hypotheses.expected_gain: Kernel-enforced spatial projection while retaining one backing inode.
hypotheses.strongest_countermechanism: Privileged loop plumbing is fragile, block writes can still escape through backing-fd paths, and complexity exceeds split.
hypotheses.counterprediction: Privileged loop plumbing is fragile, block writes can still escape through backing-fd paths, and complexity exceeds split.
hypotheses.falsifier: Subrange attack escapes bounds or operational cost > split.
hypotheses.minimum_test: losetup offset/sizelimit attack matrix on target VPS.
failure_modes: Subrange attack escapes bounds or operational cost > split.
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: No current region-view primitive reaches syscall boundary.

hypotheses.mechanism: Dedicated state-write broker owns all image write capability; cognition sends typed deltas over IPC.
hypotheses.expected_gain: Remove raw image fd from cognitive runtime.
hypotheses.strongest_countermechanism: Broker becomes confused deputy; without kernel monotonicity compromise still rewrites prefix.
hypotheses.counterprediction: Broker becomes confused deputy; without kernel monotonicity compromise still rewrites prefix.
hypotheses.falsifier: Crafted delta or broker exploit writes prefix.
failure_modes: Crafted delta or broker exploit writes prefix.
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: Current state writer itself can hold writable image fd.

hypotheses.mechanism: Copy-on-write ephemeral state overlay during runtime, merge only at externally authorized checkpoints.
hypotheses.expected_gain: Ordinary runtime never writes accepted image.
hypotheses.strongest_countermechanism: Crash continuity depends on second persistent object or loses live state; violates one-authoritative-image goal.
hypotheses.counterprediction: Crash continuity depends on second persistent object or loses live state; violates one-authoritative-image goal.
hypotheses.falsifier: Power cut loses admitted state or requires hidden persistent sidecar.
hypotheses.minimum_test: Crash/restart proof with no persistent sidecar.
failure_modes: Power cut loses admitted state or requires hidden persistent sidecar.
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: Current EUDI writes canonical state continuously.

hypotheses.mechanism: Typed binary delta codec + periodic append-only checkpoints compress MOLT metadata overhead.
hypotheses.expected_gain: Keep monotonic safety with near-split bytes/tx and bounded recovery.
hypotheses.strongest_countermechanism: Metadata and checkpoints still amplify writes; compaction cost dominates.
hypotheses.counterprediction: Metadata and checkpoints still amplify writes; compaction cost dominates.
hypotheses.falsifier: Bytes/tx >2x split or recovery > budget under realistic state corpus.
hypotheses.minimum_test: Binary codec benchmark on held-out Frank deltas.
failure_modes: Bytes/tx >2x split or recovery > budget under realistic state corpus.
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: No MOLT codec exists; JSON proxy is intentionally inefficient.

hypotheses.mechanism: Commit state only when verified outcome/causal receipts are complete; provisional state remains noncanonical.
hypotheses.expected_gain: Reduce invalid persistent transitions and bind lineage to causal closure.
hypotheses.strongest_countermechanism: Delaying all persistence harms memory/goal continuity and conflates causal reward with ordinary state.
hypotheses.counterprediction: Delaying all persistence harms memory/goal continuity and conflates causal reward with ordinary state.
hypotheses.falsifier: Legitimate non-reward state lost or latency unacceptable.
hypotheses.minimum_test: Classify state categories and lesion persistence timing.
failure_modes: Legitimate non-reward state lost or latency unacceptable.
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: Current persistence and reward admission are not the same operation.

hypotheses.mechanism: fs-verity immutable image plus external mutable journal, then periodic rebuild.
hypotheses.strongest_countermechanism: It necessarily reintroduces a second persistent state object and thus is a split design.
hypotheses.counterprediction: It necessarily reintroduces a second persistent state object and thus is a split design.
hypotheses.falsifier: Cannot satisfy one authoritative persistent image during steady state.
hypotheses.minimum_test: Kernel fs-verity write behavior + persistence topology check.
failure_modes: Cannot satisfy one authoritative persistent image during steady state.
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: Current EUDI mixes mutable and immutable bytes.

hypotheses.mechanism: Dual mapped views of same inode: read-only prefix/model mapping plus append-only tail handle.
hypotheses.expected_gain: Separate hot read topology from write handle.
hypotheses.strongest_countermechanism: A general fd still defeats view boundaries; mapping itself is not authority.
hypotheses.counterprediction: A general fd still defeats view boundaries; mapping itself is not authority.
hypotheses.falsifier: Any writer obtains positional write primitive.
failure_modes: Any writer obtains positional write primitive.
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: Current semantics do not bind OS handles to typed capabilities.

hypotheses.mechanism: Ratchet-file semantics borrowed from one-way state machines: each accepted epoch irreversibly extends history; changing root means birthing a new image lineage, not editing self.
hypotheses.expected_gain: Align physical update direction with identity lineage direction.
hypotheses.strongest_countermechanism: Metaphor adds nothing beyond append-only log and complicates upgrades.
hypotheses.counterprediction: Metaphor adds nothing beyond append-only log and complicates upgrades.
hypotheses.falsifier: No measurable difference from conventional append log + manifest.
hypotheses.minimum_test: Compare lineage invariants and recovery under adversarial replay.
failure_modes: No measurable difference from conventional append log + manifest.
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: Current root/state are layered identities but physical writes remain bidirectional.

hypotheses.mechanism: Epoch batching with one durable commit frame for multiple low-risk deltas under bounded loss budget.
hypotheses.expected_gain: Reduce fsync overhead while preserving monotonicity.
hypotheses.strongest_countermechanism: Batching weakens durability and complicates exact causal/re-entry order.
hypotheses.counterprediction: Batching weakens durability and complicates exact causal/re-entry order.
hypotheses.falsifier: Crash loses more than declared budget or changes causal semantics.
hypotheses.minimum_test: Crash cuts at every batch boundary.
failure_modes: Crash loses more than declared budget or changes causal semantics.
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: Current EUDI directive has no MOLT batching semantics.

hypotheses.mechanism: Forward error-detecting frame grammar with commit marker + cross-root/epoch chain; derived indexes rebuilt from valid prefix.
hypotheses.expected_gain: Recovery becomes suffix truncation/quarantine rather than in-place repair.
hypotheses.strongest_countermechanism: Silent bit corruption in valid frames or huge replay time still breaks recovery economics.
hypotheses.counterprediction: Silent bit corruption in valid frames or huge replay time still breaks recovery economics.
hypotheses.falsifier: Fabricated state after corruption or restart time exceeds budget.
hypotheses.minimum_test: Random corruption + structured frame mutation + long-tail recovery.
failure_modes: Fabricated state after corruption or restart time exceeds budget.
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: Current EUDI recovery hypotheses are not tied to a no-overwrite physical invariant.
